newsitems.title: Sunken Realms has a Release Date!
newsitems.author: MagicPuncher
newsitems.contents: Who's ready to finally get their hands on Sunken Realms? July was all about level design. Each of the six sections needed a total of 17 different rooms, plus a few extras here and there, which made a grand total of 109 rooms. I got probably 40 of them done in 30 days, so I've been cooking. The plan for August is to greatly improve the enemies in the later sections. They mostly have placeholder attack animations right now, and aren't particularly fun to engage with. I also hope to redo the player attack animations for claymore and spear. September I'll finish the remaining cutscenes so we can see how it ends, along with overall bug fixes and polish in general, which brings us to our release date! September 18th, 2026! 7 Weeks from today. Thanks everyone for you passion and patience, and I can't wait for you guys to finally get to play the whole thing. Stay tuned!

newsitems.title: Sunken Realms Live Stream - Part 2
newsitems.author: MagicPuncher
newsitems.contents: NEXT FEST IS HERE! Come hang out with Magic Puncher, the solo dev behind Sunken Realms, as he takes you deep into his dungeon-crawling, rogue-lite adventure! Explore procedurally generated dungeons, craft powerful builds, and fight your way through brutal enemies — all while getting a behind-the-scenes look from the one-man team who built it. Drop in, ask questions, and grab the FREE demo while you're at it!

newsitems.title: Sunken Realms Developer Livestream
newsitems.author: MagicPuncher
newsitems.contents: NEXT FEST HAS ARRIVED — and Sunken Realms is ready! Join Magic Puncher, the solo dev behind this dark dungeon-crawling rogue-lite, for a live run through procedurally generated depths packed with deadly enemies, deep loot, and brutal combat. Every run is different. Every death teaches you something. Come watch, play the FREE demo, and see what one dev has been building!

newsitems.title: New Demo Now Available!
newsitems.author: MagicPuncher
newsitems.contents: Way back in 2022, I released a demo for Sunken Realms here on Steam. Shortly thereafter I was hired full-time to work on another game, and Sunken Realms got put on the backburner. But now Sunken Realms is back and way better than ever before. I have learned quite a lot in four years and I think the demo proves that. It is a night and day difference from what it was way back then. I'm also happy to announce that Sunken Realms will be a part of Steam Next Fest in a few weeks. So if any of you guys are streamers or know any streamers, please reach out. I would love to get some more exposure. And don't worry, it won't be another four years this time. I plan to release the full game in a few short months. Stay tuned!
